intent: Land the measured floor-first decision seam in the harness core: advisory assessment before implementation, a decision provider consulted only inside the ambiguity band, and every decision recorded.

requirements.REQ-SEAM-A: An advisory assessment takes a request, its intended paths and optional observed interface impact; the deterministic floor comes from the routing rules promoted by observed impact; a decision provider is consulted only when the floor is an ambiguous STANDARD on non-test source paths; an unavailable or failing provider produces an explicit abstention; and the recommendation never lowers the enforced floor.
requirements.REQ-SEAM-B: Every assessment appends one JSON line with the request, paths, observed impact, floor, provider identity and prediction, abstention reason, disagreement flag and recommendation to the harness decision log under .harness.
requirements.REQ-SEAM-C: A CLI command runs the assessment from the repository root with a request, its intended paths and an optional base revision for observed interface impact, returning the recorded row.
